column1: # Sieve model registry. One model per line, tab-separated.
#   id           Name used with --model (letters, digits, - and _).
#   file         Model file in this folder (sieve-charmodel-v1; see SPECIFICATIONS 4.2).
#   symbols      The alphabet it models (lower27, babel29, ascii95).
#   default      yes for the one model used for that alphabet when --model is not given.
#   sha256       SHA-256 of the file. A model that no longer matches is refused, because every
#                guided address depends on every count in it.
#   description  One line, shown by sieve models.
# To add a model: build it with sieve train (it prints a ready-made line), then add the line.

column6: Order-5 lower27 model of 15 Project Gutenberg books (corpus/gutenberg-nltk.tsv), about 1.9 bits per character on held-out text
